title: neustanthus phaseoloides
intro: Neustanthus phaseoloides, commonly known as "Bhui ghas" or "Desert lavender", is a flowering plant species native to India and parts of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Neustanthus phaseoloides include sedative, antiseptic, and antimicrobial activities, making it useful in treating wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
